description: Seam 4's capture plan (ScreenCapturePlanning.PlanCaptures): enumerated monitors plus which one holds the cursor → send order (cursor's monitor first, the rest in enumeration order), screenshot size (long edge 1280, short edge Int(1280 / aspect) or Int(1280 * aspect), truncated) and label. Each label carries the ' (image dimensions: WxH pixels)' suffix added at CompanionManager.swift:603-606. input.monitors is in enumeration order; expected.captures is in send order and monitorIndex points back into input.monitors. Expected values are worked out by hand. Parity spec CLA-01.
